messages:
Priya N: quick prototype shared — compact toolbar for eval runs is up at https://figma.com/file/abcd1234. collapses to a single tools chip on small widths and when 'compact mode' is toggled. please poke for accessibility and discoverability. :eyes: Jordan C: looked — nice micro-animations. question: how do keyboard users find the hidden controls? if it collapses, is there a clear focus target? Marta L: agree with Jordan. screen readers need an explicit affordance. auto-collapse on resize can be surprising. can we keep a persistent focusable button that expands the toolbar? maybe a "Show filters" control. Samir R: also: what are the exact triggers? scroll-based collapse is flaky across browsers. prefer width-based or explicit toggle. how will this interact with the pinned filter state? Priya N: good points. current plan: collapse when viewport width < 780px OR when user enables compact mode in settings. no scroll-trigger. there will be a persistent toggle button with aria-label 'Open toolbar' and a visible pill showing active filter count. expanding restores full toolbar. animation 120ms. Jordan C: +1 for persistent toggle. can we ensure keyboard users can tab to the pill and press Enter/Space to open? also, when toolbar opens, focus should move into the first control. Marta L: for screen reader announcements we should add an aria-live region announcing "Toolbar collapsed. Press Enter to open." only when state changes. lightweight example: ```html
``` Samir R: nice snippet. ensure the sr-only class uses the standard visually-hidden pattern so it doesn't break layout. also verify on VoiceOver iOS — aria-live behavior differs. Priya N: noted. another copy nit: instead of 'Show filters' maybe 'Open toolbar' is more generic since it contains more than filters (sort, baseline, snapshot). any objections? Jordan C: 'Open toolbar' works. add a tooltip for mouse users: 'Open toolbar (Ctrl+K opens Command Palette)' — though maybe that confuses keyboard shortcut messaging. Marta L: tooltip fine, but don't overload it with shortcuts. separate hint in keyboard shortcuts doc. Priya N: accessibility acceptance criteria I'm proposing: 1) collapsed state has focusable toggle reachable via Tab. 2) Enter/Space opens toolbar and focus moves to first control. 3) aria-live announces collapse/open transitions. 4) visual indicator of active filters remains visible when collapsed. 5) Screen reader testing documented (NVDA/JAWS/VoiceOver). Samir R: add keyboard-only flow test: open via keyboard, navigate filters, capture focus order. also add unit tests for DOM state changes so regressions get caught. design-bot: Accessibility checklist updated: collapsed-toolbar -> focusable-toggle, aria-live, visible filter pill, tooltip text, animation under 200ms. See /docs/accessibility/collapsed-toolbar.md :white_check_mark: Priya N: thanks all — I'll update the prototype and put a small PR with the aria-live helper + keyboard focus management. assigning follow-ups: @Jordan C to write keyboard test cases; @Marta L to run SR checks on VoiceOver; @Samir R to add unit tests. target: ship behind flag next sprint. :rocket:
